status_of_contents: OBSERVATIONS ONLY, per the executor's role. CHECK 1 (conditional-vs-unconditional mubar_{k-1}): on the committed T=1e7 real-sampler baseline (EV-HQC-b71230's own data), the deviation from the i.i.d.-blocks approximation is POSITIVE AT EVERY k FROM 2 TO 35 (no sign flips) and GROWS MONOTONICALLY with k -- +0.42 percent at k=2, +7.63 percent at k=17 (the load-bearing order), +27.8 percent at k=26, +660 percent at k=35 (where only 5 of 1e7 trials support the estimate). On the smaller T=10,000 pooled matched-pair dataset (the source of the Red Team's original 13.4 percent figure), the same monotonic-growth pattern holds, reproducing the Red Team's number exactly at k=17 (+13.39 percent) but disagreeing with the larger dataset's +7.63 percent at the same k by a factor of roughly 1.75, with the gap widening further at higher k -- correlated with the smaller dataset's shrinking effective sample size at high k. This disagreement was not anticipated in the pre-registered framing and is reported as a distinct, unresolved fact. CHECK 2 (SE-scaling in-range): an independent reimplementation reproduced all previously-audited committed numbers to at most 1e-9 relative error. Sweeping Delta_p over [1e-6, 1.0] (both signs, 61 points) at k=17, T_req*Delta_p^2 is constant to a coefficient of variation of 2.47e-16 (machine precision), strictly monotonic, sign-symmetric, all finite and positive -- no discontinuities, sign errors, or blow-ups found, confirmed across the full k=2..26 range. This check confirms implementation correctness across a wide operating range; it does not itself validate the underlying i.i.d. approximation (Check 1's domain).
claim_boundary: Toy. Two reliability checks on already-committed data; no new experiment was run. No statement about A17, HQC's decoding-failure rate, or any standardized parameter set. Whether the observed monotonic, dataset-dependent deviation pattern is small enough to trust the ~1.38e5 global-injection projection, or warrants further caution before scoping a pilot against it, is not decided by this snapshot and is the explicit deliverable of both pending reviews.
